stem: Which statement expresses an idea about society that is developed in the excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: People can gain confidence and independence by defying the expectations of others.

options.label: B
options.text: People who travel instead of staying in one place are often better at understanding others.

options.label: C
options.text: People often present themselves in ways that are different from their true natures.

options.label: D
options.text: People who think that they have little to offer still have a special set of skills and interests.
